claims.text: Maintenance: 250 mg PO BID, a diuretic option (like HCTZ/triamterene) to prevent or reduce vertigo attacks;
claims.quote: Diuretics (eg, hydrochlorothiazide/triamterene 25 mg/37.5 mg orally once a day or acetazolamide 250 mg orally 2 times a day) may also help prevent or reduce the incidence of vertigo attacks and are commonly used as maintenance therapy.
There are no well-designed studies that clearly prove the efficacy of these measures for Meniere disease;
